questions.chapter: Hydropower Potential of Nepal & Project Classification
questions.text: Explain the Hydropower Potential of Nepal (Theoretical $83,000\,\text{MW}$, Technically feasible $45,000\,\text{MW}$, and Economically feasible $42,000\,\text{MW}$). Classify Hydropower Plants based on: (a) Head (Low, Medium, High), (b) Capacity (Micro, Mini, Small, Medium, Large), and (c) Storage (Run-of-River - RoR, Peaking RoR - PRoR, and Storage / Reservoir plants).

questions.chapter: Flow Duration Curves (FDC), Power & Energy Potential Estimation
questions.text: Explain Flow Duration Curve (FDC) and Power Duration Curve (PDC). How is design discharge $Q_d$ selected for a Run-of-River project (e.g. $Q_{40}$ or $Q_{45}$ exceedance discharge)? Derive the Hydro-Electric Power Equation: $P = \eta \cdot \gamma_w \cdot Q \cdot H_{net} = 9.81 \cdot \eta \cdot Q \cdot H_{net}\,\text{kW}$.

questions.chapter: Flow Duration Curves (FDC), Power & Energy Potential Estimation
questions.text: Define Plant Capacity Factor, Load Factor, Utilization Factor, and Diversity Factor. A hydropower plant has an installed capacity of $50\,\text{MW}$. Annual energy generation is $280\,\text{GWh}$. Calculate the Capacity Factor of the plant.

questions.chapter: Hydropower Components (Intakes, Headrace, Forebay & Surge Tanks)
questions.text: Explain hydraulic design of a Gravel Pack / Side Intake and Settling Basin (Desilting Basin) for sediment exclusion in Himalayan rivers conforming to Vetter's or Camp's settling criteria (Particle size $0.2\,\text{mm}$).

questions.chapter: Hydropower Components (Intakes, Headrace, Forebay & Surge Tanks)
questions.text: Explain Headrace Tunnel vs Headrace Canal. Why is a Forebay or Surge Tank provided between headrace and penstock? Explain Simple, Restricted Orifice, and Differential Surge Tanks.

questions.chapter: Penstocks, Anchor Blocks & Water Hammer Calculations
questions.text: Explain Economic Diameter of Penstock using empirical formulas (e.g. Sarkaria formula $D = 0.62 Q^{0.43} H^{0.14}$). Explain Penstock Wall Thickness design considering internal hydrostatic pressure and water hammer pressure: $t = \frac{P D}{2 \sigma_{all} \eta_w} + c_r$. Design Anchor Blocks and Saddle Supports.

questions.chapter: Powerhouse Layout, Turbines Selection & Electromechanical Equipment
questions.text: Explain Turbine Selection based on Specific Speed ($N_s = \frac{N\sqrt{P}}{H^{5/4}}$) and Head: Pelton ($H > 300\,\text{m}$), Francis ($50\,\text{m} < H < 400\,\text{m}$), Kaplan ($H < 50\,\text{m}$), and Cross-flow turbines. Draw the general layout of an Surface Powerhouse showing turbine, generator, governor, inlet valve, and tailrace channel.
